title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Talaaq by the way of khula 4764 views Q. Is Talaq valid if given in writing, verbally, and via SMS, but my wife did not acknowledge it? 2934 views Q. relationship with son & wife after talaq 2022 views Q. Divorce related problems 5387 views Q. I am from New Delhi.Married in August 2000.Two children,daughter 6 years old and son 3 years old now.Our married life was not happy.I work in Private Company and wife works in Govt.job. Due to differences between me and my wife,on 12th July,2008,left home,took a flat on rent, called her parents from U.P. and started living seperately.All efforts for reconcilation failed.She had even filed complaint against me in Police Station,and filed maintenance petition in 2009 against me in court,matter of which is pending. After all reconcilation efforts,including even by Court appointed mediators failed,I sent her letter of First Talaq on 26th april 2010 written in my hand writing and duly signed by two witnessess through Speed Post at her Residence address in Delhi and sent scannned copy of letter also by email to her.On phone she acknowledged receipt of both these.Then I sent second letter of Talaq again on 29th May 2010 in my own hand writing and signed by same two witnesseses again by speed post and scaned copy by email.I had also mentioned in that the reference of first talaq and that it was the second one.I got Delivery Report of Speed Post.Then on 3rd July 2010,I sent the Final and third Talaq Letter to her in same manner in my hand writing and signed by same two witnesses.I also emailed scanned copy by email to her.In that letter too I had mentioned reference of earlier two talaqs and said it is the third and final one.Again I got receipt of acknowldegement and delivery report from her end.In that third letter I had also mentioned that I want to pay her Mehar amount of Rs.one lakh only by cheque /draft and I want her to meet me at a neutral place of conbvenience so that I can hand it to over to her. Kindly note that the court case is for providing maintenance for children only.It has nothing to do with talaq.This court case she had filed in May/June 2009 much before I sent her Talaq letter in April 2010.she had filed that maintenanace case under Section 125 saying that she had been thrown out of house and as she is living seperately she needs maintenanace from my end. NOW IN LIGHT OF ABOVE FACTS: I want to know whether this talaq is proper and valid or not? Still her mehar amount is due to be paid.I am willing to pay her the amount.I had mentioned that clearly to her in my final and third talaq letter.The Bank Draft of Rs.One lakh is ready in her name.But I want to pay her in presence of witneses only. I want to know that in between the period when the mehar is yet to be paid, is talaq complete or not? 1982 views Q. They had forced me to say takaq 3 times. Then I told ??I am not giving talaq?? Again forced with all bad words and gundas again forced to say 3 time talaq again I told them NO ??I am not giving talaq?? after all pressure to save my life I had told ok ??I give her talaq?? ??MAY TUMHA TALAQ DETA HUN?? 3 times. So, Is talaq valid? 2662 views Q. Am married for 11years n got 2 kids also and had always problems with wife... many times i warned her not to show attitude like this but she never change her behave. few days we had fightings over phone and i told her dont talk to me as am very angry but she repeated and then by force i had to give her talaq... i said 4 times. many people say in anger talaq not accepted. Please guid in light of Quraan and Ahadeeth... Jazakallahu khair 2370 views Q. triplw talaq 1818 views Q. What should a man give to his wife when she takes Khula from him becausse of his own fault 19730 views Q. Is it permissible to give a woman talaaq during the 40 days period after childbirth if a man give his wife talaaq during this period is it valid. 7731 views Q. working in khula period 8334 views Q. Talaq 1749 views Q. My friend's husband wrote on a piece of paper that he has divorced her 3 times so in her mind she was divorced since he has said it once before that 2178 views Q. Three talaqs in anger 2567 views Q. Due to bad behavior with me and my 2 sons I verbally pronounced Talak thrice to my wife. She refused to acknowledge the Talak saying that there was no witness to the Talak. Thereafter I pronounced Talak in the presence of a Mufti and 2 adult muslim witnesses. The written talaknama was sent to my wife by speed post which she has refused to accept. Technically she claims to have not been divorced and her family members support her. I left my house immediately after this incident and have been living in a separate house with my 2 sons for the last 2 and half years. As per the Muslim law and the Sharia, is my Talak valid. If it is please issue me Fatwa which I can produce in court so that my Talak can be recognized. 2270 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 40469 Country: India Title: Fatwa regarding rejoining after khula. Question: I have been married one year ago, and on Jan 18, 2012, my wife took khula, but now she is repenting and want to come back to me. In this regard I consulted Maulana here in Muscat who is from Deoband, he saw the khula nama and told me that I can take her back as the khula nama is not having any condition of returning money or anything else. He quoted the fatwa from Fatawa Shami 605/2, stating that this is talaq bayin, and in this case with new nikah and new mahr rejoining is possible. Kindly help to know the confirmed fatwa from you. Answer ID: 40469 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1385/1025/D=1433) If there is neither any explanation of three talaqs in the khula nama nor you have given any talaq before khula then in this case it seems the case of talaq bayin. If you want to do nikah again on new mahr then you can do with the agreement and consent of your wife. The copy of khula nama is not before us hence we cannot give any definite ruling. However, you can follow what the Alim sahib said. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
